title: Signal, Operation and Memory types bear their root's trait, generated with the type
description: vision:ethos: Signal, Operation and Memory imply traits on the types they declare: each type bears its root's trait (the message trait, the operation trait, Memorizable), generated with it and never written. Witnessed 2026-10-30 by the Flow Nexus v1 work (Mind flowNexus, ethos-zero 19 built in Nix): the generated roots omit these implied traits, so the v1 repositories flow-nexus, signal-flow-nexus and meta-signal-flow-nexus carry hand-written impls meanwhile.
design: Ethos Zero emits, for every type declared in a Signal, Operation or Memory root, the impl of that root's trait, generated beside the type and its derive. Owner: the Mind ethos pair, reached through Psyche ethos-nexus Secondary. Ruling: Psyche core Primary 0568e3.
acceptance_criteria: Generating a Signal, an Operation and a Memory ethos file emits each type's root-trait impl; a test asserts it; the v1 hand-written impls are removed in the change that lands it.
notes: Held 2026-10-30 by the living through Psyche core Primary: nothing is generated and the Mind ethos pair does not implement before he rules on a design proposal from Psyche ethosNexus Primary — what each root implied trait is (Memorizable, the message trait, the operation trait), its capabilities in Ethos and the generated Rust, and how Ethos Zero emits them with the type; an Operation understood as an actor. It reaches the living as a book. The fifth root Output is withdrawn: an output is a Signal.

title: Ethos Zero generates a newtype for every head over a single type
description: Ruling of the living, 2026-10-30, vision:ethos: A head over a single type declares a newtype: a single-member tuple struct holding it, so every declared name is its own type and carries its own derive. Today Ethos Zero emits an alias, pub type X = Y;. Wanted: #[derive(Datomizable, Compositional)] pub struct X(pub Y); for example LockId.Integer becomes #[derive(Datomizable, Compositional)] pub struct LockId(pub Integer); and SyntaxError.Vector<FilePath> becomes #[derive(Datomizable, Compositional)] pub struct SyntaxError(pub Vec<FilePath>);
design: Replace the alias emission for a head over a single type with the newtype struct carrying the standard derive; every consumer of generated code is updated in the same change.
acceptance_criteria: Every head over a single type generates a single-member tuple struct with #[derive(Datomizable, Compositional)]; tests cover the derive on the newtype (datom round trip of a newtype value); the generated code committed in consumers is regenerated and its freshness test passes.
close_reason: Implemented and merged as 6e4198991162b0bc28a07a86e09c649130102956; Prometheus daemon-only nix flake check passed all nine checks, including generated newtype Datom round trip and freshness.
